game_title: Name Tag Match – Royal Granary Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Royal Granary, the king's grain stores: the squire must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing apples before they reach siege rats.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Granary: the king's grain stores
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Protect the castle gate from siege rats in Royal Granary: keep the tag_matches meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: tag_matches drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Royal Granary'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Royal Granary.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while tag_matches > 0.
